_about: Published aggregate of spck.dev's independent read-only probe of the public UCP merchant population. Population frame: HuggingFace dataset UCPChecker/ucp-merchants (CC-BY-4.0), status=verified. Probe: GET /.well-known/ucp with an identified User-Agent. No individual merchant is named; aggregates only. Reproducible.
signing_keys_note: WITHDRAWN. This run tested keys[] against a population that publishes signing_keys[] (renamed in ucp#566, merged 2026-07-12, first released in v2026-08-25), so it could not see them. The last correct-field measurement is history/scan-2026-07-17.json: 11 of 2974 live valid endpoints, 0.4 per cent. ops/tools/state_of_ucp_scan.py now tests both field names, so the next scan measures this correctly.
